d:
A woman time-travels.
Charlotte is a woman living in Victorian-era England. Zachary is an office worker bro living in the 21st century. But despite the distance in time, they've managed to maintain a long-distance epistolary romance, exchanging letters through a magical desk and cabinet.
But when Charlotte's mother pressures her to marry, Charlotte escapes to the 21st century, followed by would-be suitor Cecil. But adapting to modern life proves tricky for the couple, who find themselves facing gulfs that go beyond time and space.
